title: Use buy now, pay later loans? They could soon impact your credit score
summary: Yahoo Finance interview explains how FICO's new scoring model will weigh BNPL loans and what affects a user's score.

assertions.quote: for affirm users at least the majority of people will see a slight increase to their score or no impact at all

verdicts.note: Matches FICO and Affirm's own joint simulation study results, though self-reported industry-sponsored studies warrant some caution.

assertions.quote: missing any uh payments can have a serious negative impact
keep the number of loans you have going to a minimum

verdicts.note: Matches CFPB findings that roughly a third to two-thirds of BNPL borrowers had simultaneous loans in various survey periods.

assertions.quote: it would be making a change to the calculation of its credit scores to now include buy now pay later loans

verdicts.note: Confirmed by FICO's own 2025 announcement and the joint study with Affirm simulating the new model's effects.
